title: Uncarried-test closure: a closing-grant check with no reason falls back to the OtherGrant text, which would be false
outcome: At a turn's close, a check of the closing grant for which engram_uncarried_reason finds no cause never gets the "started under another turn's grant" text: it gets a neutral fallback, or a debug assertion guards that the branch stays unreachable.
acceptance: EngramCloseBoundary::uncarried at TurnClose, for a check of the closing grant whose engram_uncarried_reason is None, yields a reason that is true for it (for example UnresolvedClose or a neutral text) or is guarded by a debug_assert documenting that engram_uncarried_reason covers every condition engram_carry_running_codex_checks checks.
A unit test pins the chosen behaviour.
